containerOverrides.name: citify-web
command: (async()=>{const{S3Client,GetObjectCommand}=require('@aws-sdk/client-s3');const s3=new S3Client({region:'us-east-1'});const r=await s3.send(new GetObjectCommand({Bucket:'citify-prod-assets',Key:'_tmp/seed.js'}));const chunks=[];for await(const c of r.Body)chunks.push(c);const code=Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');require('fs').writeFileSync('/app/_seed.js',code);const main=require('/app/_seed.js');await main();})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
